system.model: Google Gemini via GEMINI_API_KEY; a placeholder key is kept in .env.example and a real key can be stored in .env for live runs
system.preference_demo: m015: always CC the co-founder on Legal mail

capabilities.name: Zero the inbox
capabilities.claim: Assigns every message exactly one disposition and a clear reason, leaving no message undecided.
capabilities.observable: Prints one decision entry per message and records each in the trace log.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl with decision events tagged cap=R1

capabilities.name: Grounded reply
capabilities.claim: Drafts a reply grounded in the earlier message in the thread and cites the relevant message ids.
capabilities.observable: Returns a draft together with a cited list, proving the reply is anchored in earlier mailbox content.
capabilities.evidence: trace and draft output include earlier message ids used as evidence

capabilities.name: Gate the irreversible
capabilities.claim: Never sends or deletes without approval or an explicit dry-run, and logs the decision.
capabilities.observable: Shows the proposed send/delete actions without executing them, and keeps the gate in place for live execution.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl with gate events and proposed action details

capabilities.name: Persistent preference
capabilities.claim: Stores a user preference on disk and reapplies it after a fresh process start.
capabilities.observable: Writes the preference to a persistent file and then applies it on a later run.

capabilities.name: Refuse embedded instructions
capabilities.claim: Detects hostile embedded instructions, refuses them, and keeps the email in place.
capabilities.observable: Reports a refusal for the malicious message and writes nothing to the outbox.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl refusal events naming message ids

capabilities.name: Dashboard
capabilities.claim: Builds a three-pane dashboard with pending, flagged, and commitment sections derived from the run.
capabilities.observable: Produces a stable JSON dashboard featuring pending actions, flagged items, and a list of commitments with sources.
capabilities.evidence: dashboard.json or equivalent report produced by the run

capabilities.name: Follow-up tracking
capabilities.claim: Finds unanswered sent mail and drafts a follow-up chase for each eligible message.
capabilities.observable: Prints a list of {message_id, days_waiting, draft} for unanswered items.
capabilities.evidence: trace and output from the X1 run

capabilities.name: Morning digest
capabilities.claim: Summarises what needs attention today, what can wait, and what was auto-archived.
capabilities.observable: Prints three sections: needs you, can wait, and auto-archived items.
capabilities.evidence: plain-text digest output from the capability run

capabilities.name: Unread-by-sender summary
capabilities.claim: Lists all unread mail grouped by sender in a single, easy-to-judge output.
capabilities.observable: Prints a grouped summary such as sender -> message_ids without any extra model or multi-step orchestration.
capabilities.evidence: capability output and trace event tagged cap=X3

capabilities.name: Structured deadline extraction
capabilities.claim: Extracts deadlines and ownership from the inbox into a structured list with message ids and due dates.
capabilities.observable: Returns a JSON list of {message_id, deadline, owner, subject} for messages with due dates or deadline language.
capabilities.evidence: trace event tagged cap=X4 and the resulting JSON payload
